transcript:
Agent: Thank you for calling Nimbus Telecom. My name is Arjun. How can I help you today?
Customer: Hi Arjun, I'm Aisha Nair. I'm calling because my latest bill is completely wrong and I'm honestly fed up with these constant errors.
Agent: I need your account number to access the details.
Customer: It is 63428001.
Agent: I see the charge. What is the issue?
Customer: You've charged me twice for the international roaming package. I'm tired of this. I'm just going to cancel my service and switch to another provider.
Agent: I will raise a refund request for the duplicate charge now.
Customer: Fine, but I still want to cancel. I live at 326 Brigade Road and my phone is 95213 13640.
Agent: Any refund or credit is subject to approval and will take 7 to 10 business days to process. Regarding the cancellation, there is no early termination fee, and your final bill will arrive in the next billing cycle.
Customer: Okay. I also have an outstanding balance of twenty dollars that I want to pay now so there are no issues.
Agent: Provide the card details.
Customer: It is four one three seven two one five nine zero one zero nine two eight one nine.
Agent: Payment processed. I will now process the cancellation request for your account.
Customer: Alright, that's all I needed.
Agent: Is there anything else I can assist you with? I have requested the refund and processed your cancellation. Goodbye.
